groups.name: clock_reset
groups.semantics: Same actual model instance; low before rising, high after settled eval. Observer records once per rising edge, never per eval.

groups.name: router_selection
groups.semantics: ResidentRun=3 from Enum(idle,ordinary,reducing,residentRun). Do not infer resident selection from !reductionOwns.

groups.name: resident_group_accept
groups.semantics: Read identity,gate.tag,up.tag,act.tag,gate.m,up.m,act.m on both actual handshakes. identity17 differs from actual act owner18.

groups.name: resident_group_terminal
groups.semantics: Actual routed result fire; successful group terminal alone is not B retirement or Host terminal.

groups.name: resident_abort
groups.semantics: Observe each edge including after earlier provisional capture; any abort is fatal.

groups.name: bridge_call
groups.semantics: Latch coordinates only from actual accepted call, enforce128x160 and ng multiples160; state ordinals fixed by source Enum.

groups.name: bridge_tile_state
groups.semantics: Read real slot tags and counters; response consumes at edge so pre-edge consumed==index. No inferred bank validity.

groups.name: bridge_tile_io
groups.semantics: Match response only to prior accepted read. Gate slot0 then up slot1; output slot2 is act product, never SiLU intermediate.

groups.name: bridge_loan_io
groups.semantics: The resident port has NO binaryAdd field. Match exact gate hold and same-edge up response to actual bridge loan request.

groups.name: router_loan_io
groups.semantics: Read both request/result valid+ready and payloads. Only shared io.vector has binaryAdd, selected resident forces false; retain actual r selection.

groups.name: owner_loan_io
groups.semantics: Active follows actual owner loan acceptance and clears on real vector result.fire. Never infer from raw tap valid.

groups.name: vector_loan_io
groups.semantics: Compare every original payload along five request/result interfaces, and retain exact latched operands during active loan.

groups.name: vector_phase_and_raw_tap
groups.semantics: raw event is issue phase5 of existing phase4 materialized register. Capture unchanged lane bits only after actual edge, matching live resident loan. Reject binaryAdd or phase5 product.

groups.name: host_failure_sideband
groups.semantics: Host aggregate poison participates in current and post-edge rejection; no new external Host ABI.

groups.name: profile_and_hierarchy
groups.semantics: Source-level logical routes only, NOT generated C++ names. Validate actual source/elaboration profile and each symbol+width after generation. Missing fields remain INCOMPLETE. ScheduledSiluOwner selects VectorSiluOwner with overlap=false.

sampling: One settled low-clock snapshot, then actual model rising edge and settled high snapshot. pre events determine fires; post controls validate transitions. No post payload used to replace pre capture.
required_later: Resolve every leaf in actual generated hierarchy or fail/incomplete; type/signal mapping must receive separate source and runtime review.
derivation: Retains logical contract fields; replaces source-location strings with logical module names. No environment or generated runtime symbol metadata.
